Context: (b) Voluntary Retirement under Rule 43 of Pension Rules-

A notice of voluntary retirement given after completion of twenty years' qualifying service will require acceptance by the Appointing Authority if the date of retirement on the expiry of the notice would be earlier than the date on which the Government servant concerned could have retired voluntarily under the existing rules applicable to him [ e.g., FR 56 (k), Rule 42 of the CCS (Pension) Rules, 2021, Article 459 of CSRs or any other similar rule]. Such acceptance may be generally given in all cases
